newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Halla Group says in cement plant venture in Oman.
newsitem.headline: Halla Group says in cement plant venture in Oman.

text.p: The Halla Group has signed an agreement with an Omani company to jointly build and operate a cement plant in the Middle East country, a company statement said on Monday.
Halla and Global Enterprises plan to set up the 3.7 million ton plant in the Bimah area of Oman, it said.
The export-oriented plant is expected to have two production lines.
After completion of preliminary studies, Halla and Global will establish a joint venture to construct the plant. Other details, including equity structure, will be worked out later, Halla said.
Halla added it is seeking to establish a hot briquetted iron plant in Oman.
